intro: Trying to find USA scholarships for international students with a January deadline usually means balancing urgency with fit. This filtered view brings together a focused set of listings where deadline timing is the key starting point, so you can compare options before earlier application windows pass. The programs below span areas such as education, STEM, medicine, humanities, community, and more, with study levels that can include graduate students, high school students, and adult learners. Award amounts vary widely by listing, and requirements are not all the same: some may ask for essays, while others appear lighter-touch. Because deadline wording differs from row to row and some opportunities may be coming up soon, it is smart to check each listing promptly and verify details on the official source before you apply.
